name: Platinic-Doxology
description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against massive canyon systems, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Extremophile bacteria thrive in the mineral seeps, painting slow, living terraces.
Instruments disagree about the spatial rift remnant: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
For traders, biomass, exotic matter and fusion fuel alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
